projects.title: AWS E-commerce ETL Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end AWS data pipeline processing e-commerce data from CSV and APIs into a scalable data lake architecture.

details.problem: Data from multiple sources (CSV transactions + product API) needed to be unified into a centralized analytics system.
details.solution: Built a serverless AWS pipeline using S3, Lambda ingestion, Glue ETL, and Athena querying.
results: Built full serverless AWS data pipeline
Enabled scalable SQL analytics via Athena

projects.title: ETL Log Processing Pipeline
projects.description: High-performance ETL pipeline processing 1.8M+ server logs with PostgreSQL, Airflow, and batch optimization.

details.problem: Large-scale unstructured logs (~1.8M records) required structured transformation and reliable ingestion.
details.solution: Built modular ETL pipeline with Bash extraction, Python transformation, and PostgreSQL staging + upsert design.
results: Sub-minute bulk loading via PostgreSQL COPY

projects.title: Multi-Source Crypto Analytics Pipeline
projects.description: Real-time crypto pipeline comparing CoinGecko and Kraken using Snowflake and Prefect orchestration.

details.problem: Crypto data varies significantly across exchanges, making price comparison unreliable.
details.solution: Built multi-source ingestion pipeline normalizing CoinGecko and Kraken into unified Snowflake schema.
